The structure of Mn2W2N4 (MnWN2) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows N centers in octahedral coordination with 6 neighbors (2 Mn, 4 W), while Mn and W centers each have 8 neighbors (6 N and 2 of the other transition metal), with Mn–N distances near 2.22 Å and W–N near 2.06 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 8 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner- and edge-sharing between N octahedra, plus corner- and face-sharing between Mn and W 8-vertex polyhedra.
